assets.exactPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square PBR albedo texture for the warm-white paper surface of an animator's drawing table. Generate only flat paper stock viewed exactly straight-on, evenly illuminated: dense visible cellulose fibers, restrained warm-grey tonal mottling, faint fine graphite dust and a few isolated tiny worn flecks. The palette is natural ivory / warm off-white with low-contrast grey and pale beige detail. High tactile physical texture at close range, no regular pattern. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges. No writing, letters, symbols, objects, numbers, borders, folds, shadows, perspective, scene lighting, directional gradients or baked occlusion. No black speck clusters. Aim for a 1024 square surface texture. This is a new material asset, visually informed by a cream paper animator's table, not a scene illustration.
assets.role: Retained paper-stock reference study. The rebuilt scene currently uses project-authored paper-fibers/roughness maps.
assets.contains: Surface fibres/mottling only; no live UI, writing or complete scene.
